content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional payment infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital products

The inability to use popular payment processors like Stripe and PayPal limits the potential of digital creators in regions where these services are unavailable. This situation creates a structural gap in the market, preventing creators from easily monetizing their skills and products. The core issue isn't just the absence of a platform; it's the lack of a reliable infrastructure that empowers creators to operate independently. A sovereign commerce infrastructure is essential, as it enables creators to regain control over their sales processes, ensuring they are not subject to arbitrary restrictions imposed by international payment services.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Sovereign commerce infrastructure utilizes a combination of free tools and services to create a seamless online selling experience. By leveraging resources like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing, creators can set up an online store without reliance on major platforms. The architecture includes backend services such as Cloudflare Workers for logic handling and Supabase for order storage, all while ensuring data ownership remains with the creator. This stack not only ensures cost-effectiveness but also provides the flexibility necessary for creators to adapt their businesses without external constraints.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors are either unavailable or unreliable. It is an ideal solution for those producing and selling digital goods like ebooks, courses, and software. By catering to the unique needs of these creators, the sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers them to reach global markets without the barriers imposed by conventional payment gateways. This approach not only democratizes access to e-commerce but also fosters an environment where creativity can thrive unimpeded.
Own your infrastructure, don’t rent it.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack is made up of several key components that work in unison to facilitate online sales. For hosting, creators can utilize GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both of which offer free and reliable service. Payment processing is handled through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and incurs minimal fees. The backend logic can be managed using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, while Supabase serves as the database for storing order information. This interconnected architecture ensures that every part functions seamlessly, providing a stable and efficient selling environment.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first choose your hosting platform—either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Then, integrate NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. Store your orders in Supabase, ensuring you have full ownership of your data. Finally, upload your digital products and test the entire system to confirm that everything operates smoothly. For a comprehensive solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which can be deployed within 48 hours, providing you with everything needed to launch your store effectively.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Empower your creativity without conventional limits.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
